# v0.4.0 — first GROVE release

The project is now GROVE: GLANCE Records Organised for Viewing and Exploration.

- Renames the distribution and GitHub repository to `glance-grove`, and the
  Python package and command to `grove`. The previous names have no compatibility
  aliases or import shims.
- Restores complete **Cite as** blocks in paper details, including full titles,
  recorded TeX titles and DOI-aligned citations. Improves citation typography and
  wrapping of long publication links on narrow screens.
- Adds `grove --version`, reporting the installed distribution version. Updates
  documentation, demo commands, generated-page branding and packaged resources
  to use the new names.

## Upgrading from v0.3.0

Install the `glance_grove-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl` artifact in a fresh Python 3.13
environment. Pip treats `glance-grove` and `glance-analysis-lister` as separate
projects; installing the new distribution does not remove the old one.

Replace `analysis-lister` with `grove` in shell commands and automation, and
`analysis_lister` with `grove` in Python imports and module invocations. Update
dependency declarations to `glance-grove`. Use `grove --version` or
`python -m grove --version` to verify the installation.

The repository is https://github.com/knutzk/glance-grove and documentation is at
https://knutzk.github.io/glance-grove/. Update Git remotes and documentation links;
the old GitHub Pages address does not automatically redirect.

The curated data schema, snapshot filenames and generated group-page URLs are
unchanged. Structurally valid saved snapshots remain readable, with advisory
warnings for the old generator identity. Rebuild from a saved API snapshot with
`grove build-registry` to recover full paper titles omitted by older curated
snapshots, then render into a separate output directory with `grove render-group`.
No fresh CERN download is needed. Preserve custom citation stores and policies
outside the environment and pass their explicit paths when rebuilding.

Historical v0.1.0–v0.3.0 tags and distribution artifacts retain their original
names and contents. They are not `glance-grove` packages.

Python 3.13+ and GPL-3.0-only licensing remain unchanged. Existing 0.x interface
and generated-data support limits still apply. Live retrieval requires authorised
CERN access; synthetic and offline checks do not establish live login.
